key.jaymoskingdoms.thrall_wake: Wake from your thrall (with sneak, ride the next)
speech.jaymoskingdoms.get.turn.0: You made me. I outgrew you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.get.turn.1: I answer to no one now.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.get.come.0: Our blood is hunted. I come.
%1$s keeps their company out all night. I do not like it.
Ever since %1$s came by, our own go off at night and come back pale.
Somebody is keeping my kin from their bed. %1$s, I would say.
%1$s has a hold on our people. They are not themselves.
Where does my cousin go at night? Ask %1$s.
They say %1$s has been walking our folk out after dark.
Family should be home by night. %1$s knows why mine is not.
I saw my own kin follow %1$s into the dark. Mark me.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.280: Hold a villager of the old folk, or a tamed horse or wolf, in your stare and drink from them, calmly, on three separate nights, and they are yours for good. Their kin will notice the nights away.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.281: A servant of yours takes the same four orders as a companion. Feed them a bottle of blood now and then; one forgotten long enough grows weak, and then is lost.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.282: Lie in your coffin by day, sneak-use it with a servant near, and you can look out through their eyes, walk them, use their hands, and carry for you. Your own body can still be staked.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.283: A servant standing in a temple, or near holy things, throws you out of their eyes. A priest's cure, or your death, frees them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.284: Those your bite turns are yours: you feel where they are. At night they heed your orders, and may come when you are hunted. One whose blood grows older than yours may turn on you.
